item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, a Port St. Lucie teenager named Youth of the Year for the Southeast Region of the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, will serve as an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: DEA warns meth surge spreading to Treasure Coast as cocaine prices rise
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County seized about 120 pounds of crystal meth in two days. Special Agent Kevin Bobbitt said the surge is tied to high cocaine prices and is beginning to spread north.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen named Southeast Region Youth of the Year wins trip to FIFA World Cup finals
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz was surprised Friday at the Boys & Girls Club of St. Lucie County in Fort Pierce with a trip to serve as a Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb offers panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean and the Jupiter Inlet.

item.description: A new Aldi grocery store opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, bringing more affordable options to Martin County shoppers facing tight budgets. item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August debut
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League released the nicknames and logos of its four teams Wednesday, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon to reach final after dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Ninth-ranked Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday.

item.title: Park Vista football team targets state playoffs after winning four of final five games in 2025
item.description: Park Vista Community High School's Cobras football team is building on late-season momentum as they prepare for the 2026 season.

item.title: Florida back-to-school sales tax holiday runs July 20 through August 20
item.description: Florida families can save on clothing, school supplies, computers and learning aids during the state's 32-day tax-free shopping period.
